notes: Re-fit against the 17-page even-page sample. Column centers were stable after width normalization; one sample page had a slightly narrower crop, but the same geometry still held after rescaling.
Interior split lines follow observed projection minima at approximately x = 287, 524, 758, 1000, 1228, 1468, 1706.
Outer bounds were pulled inward to suppress frame-line bleed into the first and last OCR crops. That is the main correction relative to the seed template.

Vertical trimming was left disabled in the hard template because the top and bottom frame line position is not stable enough to crop globally without risking clipped glyphs on dense pages. inner_frame_hint is diagnostic only.
No nonzero tilt model is justified by this sample. Treat proposals above about 10 px horizontal drift per 1000 px vertical run as suspect.
